about: The manuscript's paragraph menu «نوع الفقرة» (D74, D94, PHASE7_SPEC §4.4): its choices in order, as `assembly.services.BLOCK_ROLES` (every kind the book page and the exports know for a block of text), each with the digit that picks it while the menu is open (`key`, the book page's ⌘⌥ digits; «حاشية» has none). Before the text is edited each choice posts the roles endpoint with the block's lines: the review service stores the effective role per line; «اقتباس» and «ملاحظة وسط» store `body` and keep the style in `Book.assembly_settings.line_styles` (line id → style). Once the text is edited on the book page the choice posts `editedRequest` (editors) and the edited block changes, nothing re-assembles. A paragraph whose attrs carry `noteFor` (its leading marker's call is open on its page) reads the footnote choice as `footnoteFor` with n = noteFor. The current choice of a block: h2 → heading, h3 → subheading, a paragraph with `style` «verse» / «quote» / «center» → that style, any other paragraph → body.

400 (a line of a page whose text is not.detail: الصفحة ليست جاهزة للمراجعة بعد؛ انتظر حتى ينتهي التعرّف على نصها.

404.detail: السطر غير موجود في هذا الكتاب.

409.detail: حُرِّر نص هذا الكتاب في صفحة الكتاب، وإعادة تجميعه تستبدل النص المحرَّر بنص الصفحات. أكّد الاستبدال أولًا.

400.detail: لم يُحرَّر نص هذا الكتاب بعد؛ يُغيَّر نوع الفقرة من أسطرها.

400 (a note without its call).detail: لا تبدأ هذه الفقرة بعلامة حاشية مثل «(1)».

404.detail: لم تُعثر على الفقرة في النص المحرَّر؛ أعد تحميل الصفحة.

blockAfter.heading: h<first line id>
blockAfter.quote: p<first line id> with style quote: its lines form a paragraph of their own
blockAfter.verse: p<id of each line>: one verse paragraph per line
blockAfter.center: p<first line id> with style center: its lines form a paragraph of their own
blockAfter.footnote: the block leaves the body: its lines become the note n<first line id>
